t: 那不勒斯和匈牙利国王查理三世被暗杀于布达.
te: King Charles III of Naples and Hungary is assassinated at Buda.
dz: 那不勒斯和匈牙利国王查理三世被暗杀于布达.
de: King Charles III of Naples and Hungary is assassinated at Buda.

t: 瓦瓦季斯瓦夫 二世·贾吉奥 (乔盖拉)被加冕为波兰国王.
te: Władysław II Jagiełło (Jogaila) is crowned King of Poland.
dz: 瓦瓦季斯瓦夫 二世·贾吉奥 (乔盖拉)被加冕为波兰国王.
de: Władysław II Jagiełło (Jogaila) is crowned King of Poland.

t: 英格兰和葡萄牙正式批准它们与"温莎条约"的签署所结成的联盟,使其成为世界上最古老的外交联盟,至…
te: England and Portugal formally ratify their alliance with the signing of the Treaty of Windsor, making it the oldest dip…
dz: 英格兰和葡萄牙正式批准它们与"温莎条约"的签署所结成的联盟,使其成为世界上最古老的外交联盟,至今仍然有效.
de: England and Portugal formally ratify their alliance with the signing of the Treaty of Windsor, making it the oldest diplomatic alliance in the world which is still in force.

t: 旧瑞士邦联通过在塞姆帕赫战役中稳妥地击败奥地利公国,在建立对其领土的控制上取得了长足的进步.
te: The Old Swiss Confederacy makes great strides in establishing control over its territory by soundly defeating the Duchy…
dz: 旧瑞士邦联通过在塞姆帕赫战役中稳妥地击败奥地利公国,在建立对其领土的控制上取得了长足的进步.
de: The Old Swiss Confederacy makes great strides in establishing control over its territory by soundly defeating the Duchy of Austria in the Battle of Sempach.

t: 阿尔巴尼亚普林斯多姆的统治者卡尔·托皮亚与威尼斯共和国结成了联盟,承诺参加共和国的所有战争并接…
te: Karl Topia, the ruler of Princedom of Albania, forges an alliance with the Republic of Venice, committing to participat…
dz: 阿尔巴尼亚普林斯多姆的统治者卡尔·托皮亚与威尼斯共和国结成了联盟,承诺参加共和国的所有战争并接受海岸保护来对抗奥斯曼人.
de: Karl Topia, the ruler of Princedom of Albania, forges an alliance with the Republic of Venice, committing to participate in all wars of the Republic and receiving coastal protection against the Ottomans in return.

de: The Universität Heidelberg holds its first lecture, making it the oldest German university.
